statement: Every offer or sale of a security using interstate commerce or the mails is unlawful unless a registration statement is in effect (sale) or filed (offer), or an exemption applies (15 U.S.C. § 77e(a), (c)); section 4(a)(2) exempts transactions by an issuer not involving any public offering (15 U.S.C. § 77d(a)(2)), the exemption startup financings rely on, usually through its Rule 506 safe harbor.
caveat: A SAFE, convertible note, or preferred share is a security. Whether a given financing fits § 4(a)(2) or a safe harbor is a facts-and-circumstances determination; this repo does not determine exemption eligibility.
